findings.headline_summary: Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee Operating Framework: The policy repo rate under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) serves as the anchor rate for money market interest rates. The Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) rate operates at repo rate minus 25 bps (6.25% when repo is 6.50%), and the Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) operates at repo rate plus 25 bps (6.75%). The MPC targets medium-term consumer price index (CPI) headline inflation of 4.0% within a +/- 2.0% tolerance band.

findings.summary: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 — Regulation 30: Every listed entity shall promptly make disclosures of any events or information which, in the opinion of the board of directors, are material. Material events under Schedule III Part A must be disclosed to recognized stock exchanges (NSE/BSE) as soon as reasonably possible and no later than: (a) thirty minutes from the closure of the board meeting for outcome disclosures; (b) twelve hours from occurrence for events originating within the entity; (c) twenty-four hours from occurrence for external events.
